The '''Katarr system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katarr/Legends|Katarr]].
